# proxmox_node_ceph_init (Resource)

Initializes Ceph on a node through `POST /nodes/{node}/ceph/init`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_ceph_init" "c" {
  node     = "pve-1"
  network  = "10.0.0.0/24"
  triggers = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `triggers` (Map of String)

### Optional

- `cluster_network` (String)
- `disable_cephx` (Boolean)
- `min_size` (Number)
- `network` (String)
- `pg_bits` (Number)
- `size` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `upid` (String)
